# Unicorner

> Unicorner is a free daily football (soccer) trivia game in the browser, at https://unicornergame.lol. Every day there are five football questions with 30 seconds each, and the twist is that obvious answers score least: the rarer your valid answer, the more points it is worth. No download and no sign-up needed to play. Available in English and Spanish.

## How it works

- A new game every day, the same five questions for everyone.
- Each question asks you to name one valid player, club, country, manager or stadium, for example "Name a country that has won the World Cup".
- You have 30 seconds per question.
- Scoring depends on how rare your answer is. The most obvious answers are a Tap-in (10 points), then Header (30), Volley (60), Bicycle kick (85), and the rarest valid answers are a Screamer (100 points).
- The highest possible score is 500.
- If you type a common near miss (for example a player who joined a season too late), a "VAR check" explains why it does not count, and you can try again while the clock runs.
- At the end you get your score and can share it, Wordle-style.
- New players get a short how-to-play walkthrough the first time they visit.

## Features

- Global leaderboard: a ranking for each day's game and a weekly ranking that resets every Monday; yesterday's winner is shown at the top. Signing in with an email and picking a nickname puts you on it.
- Private leagues: create a league, send the link to friends, and compare daily and weekly scores.
- 1v1 duels: challenge a friend (by link, or from the leaderboard) to rounds of five questions; rarer answers hit harder until someone is knocked out. Each player keeps a win-draw-loss record.
- Also known as soccer trivia: Unicorner is a daily soccer trivia game playable worldwide in English and Spanish.
- Kits: 40 outfits for your pixel-art unicorn, unlocked by playing (games played, streaks, Screamers, high scores). The rarest, the Cosmic GOAT, is only for players who win a day.
- Weekly trophies: every Monday at midnight the past week is wrapped up and trophies are handed out, such as Champion (most points), Golden Boot (most Screamers), Ever-present (played all seven days) and Hat-trick (three Screamers in one game). They live in a trophy cabinet and show as badges next to names on the leaderboard.
- Streaks for playing on consecutive days.
- Infinity mode: endless practice with the same rules and no ranking (a short trial run is available now; the full version is coming soon).
- Retro pixel-art, arcade style.

## More daily games, hosted by Horacio Herradura

- Rosco (https://unicornergame.lol/rosco.html): a daily A-to-Z football quiz. One clue for every letter (players, clubs, managers), five minutes on the clock, and you can pass a letter to come back to it later. Daily ranking for signed-in players.
- Millions (https://unicornergame.lol/millon.html, also /million): a daily football money-drop quiz. You start with 1,000,000 and get 8 questions with 4, 3 and finally 2 options; spread the money over the answers and keep only what lands on the right one. Daily ranking and today's average.
- Both are free, new every day at midnight (Amsterdam time), and in English and Spanish (/es/rosco.html, /es/millon.html).

## Good to know

- Free to play. No app to install; works on phone and desktop browsers.
- Often described as a "football Wordle" or a daily football quiz for people with real ball knowledge.
- Spanish version: https://unicornergame.lol/es/ (in Spanish the Screamer is called "Qué chicharro").

## Quick answers

- What is Unicorner? A free daily football trivia game where the rarest valid answer scores the most.
- What is a Screamer? The rarest valid answer to a question, worth 100 points.
- Is it like Wordle? Yes: one game a day, the same questions for everyone, and a shareable score. You name players, clubs or countries instead of guessing a word.
- Do I need an account? No. Signing in is only needed for the leaderboard, private leagues and trophies.
- Is there an app? No, it runs in any phone or desktop browser.

## En español

Unicorner es un juego diario y gratis de trivia de fútbol en https://unicornergame.lol/es/. Cada día hay cinco preguntas de fútbol con 30 segundos cada una, y la respuesta obvia puntúa menos: cuanto más rara sea tu respuesta válida, más puntos vale. La respuesta más rara es un "Qué chicharro" (100 puntos). Hay ranking diario y semanal, ligas privadas con amigos, trofeos semanales y equipaciones para tu unicornio. También hay dos juegos diarios presentados por Horacio Herradura: el Rosco de fútbol (https://unicornergame.lol/es/rosco.html), una pista por cada letra contra el reloj, y Millones (https://unicornergame.lol/es/millon.html), donde empiezas con un millón y solo te llevas lo que caiga en la respuesta correcta.
